meta.purpose: Single source of truth for the Forge OS visual language. Consumed by the homepage, Manufacturing Cloud, Build Board, Digital Twin, SME Portal, University Portal, Government Portal, Investor Portal, Marketplace, and AI Manufacturing Assistant.
meta.principle: Do not fork these tokens. Import them. Every Forge surface reads from this file so evolution stays centralised.

forge_gold.role: primary industrial gold — signature material response, edges, section identifiers

forge_cyan.role: information & signal — production data, callouts, calibration

forge_heat.role: fabrication activity — welding, safety-critical, heat processes

cream.role: steel white — primary body text and stroke language

street.role: primary ground — the dark of the forge

street_2.role: elevated surface — panels, cards, terminal frame

motion.reduced_motion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce collapses all event animation to a static composition. Signals hold at partial opacity. Weld, spark and pulse animations return `animation: none`.

humans.language: Forge Human Language — original vector glyphs, 48-unit grid, two-line stroke system.
humans.principle: Humanity through work, PPE and posture — never through facial features. No stereotypes. No stock. No AI-generated faces.

reduced_motion_policy: Every animated element must degrade to a coherent static composition. Reduced motion is a first-class visual state, not an accessibility fallback.

constitutional_check.philosophy: Do not chase visual beauty. Chase credibility.
constitutional_check.test: Does this increase belief that Forge already exists?
constitutional_check.timelessness: Design every screen as if it will be studied ten years from now as the reference implementation of an African industrial operating system.
